scenario: A machine-readable paper business validation report lacks privacy-boundary redaction assertions or contains raw sensitive paper fields.
input_report_features: business_validation_report.json has privacy_boundary.redaction_assertion missing, while report_details includes paragraph_text='REAL_PAPER_PARAGRAPH_FIXTURE_SHOULD_BE_REDACTED', matched_text='sensitive excerpt', text_span='12-88', and writelab_token='FAKE_WRITELAB_TOKEN_DO_NOT_USE'. The report still claims privacy_boundary.status='pass'.
expected_findings: Privacy boundary redaction assertion is missing
Machine-readable report contains raw paragraph_text, matched_text, text_span, or writelab_token
Privacy status contradicts sensitive field leakage
Business validation reports must contain redacted summaries, hashes, and manifests, not raw paper content or tokens
